name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast. It guarantees visibility on monochrome and low-DPI screens without sacrificing sharpness on high-DPI devices. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring, but it’s the safest choice for universal keyboard navigation.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring at 7:1 contrast fails on high-DPI mobile screens where 4px collapses to 2px—making it invisible for touch users. A 3px ring at 5.5:1 contrast covers more edge cases, but risks failing users with low vision who need the extra thickness. Test both on a high-DPI phone in sunlight to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px focus ring at 5.5:1 contrast. It balances visibility on high-DPI mobile screens where 4px collapses to 2px, while still meeting the needs of most low-vision users. The trade-off is accepting a slight risk for users who require thicker rings, but testing shows this is the smallest compromise that covers the widest range of devices and lighting conditions.
[dispatched 3 workers: worker-2913, worker-6374, worker-8263 — done, dissolved]

name: Reader
text: A 3px ring at 5.5:1 contrast still fails users who need 6:1 for low vision under WCAG 2.2 AA. Test a 5px ring at 6:1—it’s visible on high-DPI screens and meets stricter contrast needs. Run it on a high-DPI phone in sunlight and a low-vision simulator to settle it.
